podcast.body: An instrumental piece from his 2004 album "Is There Love in Space?". Three years later, Coldplay's song "Viva La Vida" was alleged to have a similar melody, leading Satriani to file a lawsuit against Coldplay. An undisclosed, sealed settlement was eventually reached out of court. "And on that record is a piece entitled If I Could Fly."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This instrumental piece from the 2004 album *Is There Love in Space?* was at the center of a lawsuit Satriani filed against Coldplay, alleging that their 2008 song "Viva La Vida" plagiarized its melody. A "settlement that was sealed by the court" was reached, with Satriani receiving a settlement and keeping its details confidential. "You compare the melodies of that Coldplay song to If I Could Fly from Joe Centriani."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
